the current mixed-capability standalone provider identity begins with cub- and is therefore covered by basename_prefixes

non_claims: A reviewed basename does not authenticate the executable bytes found on PATH or at an arbitrary path.

No direct standalone add-on invocation is admitted by this inventory; every prefix-covered basename and reviewed alias asks the person before it runs in a Pilot-active assistant shell, except cub-scout, which the Scout hook decides.
A literal executable renamed outside the cub- prefix and outside this exact inventory is not detected by basename classification.
The reviewed examples source identifies eks-manager as the project directory, not an executable basename; only cub-eks is admitted as the standalone executable identity, and it asks before it runs.
